svg.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.text: SHUFFLER PCB (Version 0) - Qspice baseline: complete model with parasitics
Three Aiko modules, two two-phase converters (STD45N10F7 + ERUC23-4R1K + TMCS1126), 1ED3140 gate drive with bootstrap, copper / package / capacitor / cable parasitics.
Open loop: 50 % duty, 200 kHz, 200 ns dead time, legs 180 deg apart. Every parasitic and setting is a .param in the PARAMETERS block at the bottom left - edit values there.
Node names: PV1P / PV2P / PV3P / GND = string nodes (KiCad PV1+, PV2+, PV3+, GND). T1 / M1 / B1 = converter-1 rails behind the copper lumps, SWA1 / SWB1 = switch nodes,
gTA1 gBA1 gTB1 gBB1 = gates, BOOTA1 / BOOTB1 = bootstrap nodes, VREG1 = 12 V rail, PWM_AH1 .. = NUCLEO outputs. Same for converter 2 with suffix 2. Generated by PCB_Baseline/gen_shuffler.py --report.
